description: This file defines the internal abstract class GrainTimer and related classes for managing timers within the Orleans runtime, including scheduling, invocation, and disposal logic for grain timers.

classes.name: GrainTimer
classes.description: Abstract class implementing the core logic for Orleans grain timers, including scheduling, callback invocation, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: GrainTimer<T>
classes.description: Generic subclass of GrainTimer allowing specific callback and state types.

classes.name: InterleavingGrainTimer
classes.description: Subclass of GrainTimer configured for interleaving timer execution.

classes.name: IGrainTimerInvoker
classes.description: Interface for invoking grain timer callbacks, enabling call filter behavior.

methods.name: Change
methods.description: Adjusts the timer due time and period.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the timer and cleans up resources.

methods.name: InvokeCallbackAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to invoke the timer callback asynchronously.

methods.name: InvokeGrainTimerCallbackAsync
methods.description: Invokes the callback for the timer, handling success and exceptions.

methods.name: OnTickCompleted
methods.description: Handles the completion of a timer tick, scheduling the next tick.

methods.name: OnCallbackException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during callback invocation.

methods.name: AwaitCallbackTask
methods.description: Awaits the callback task, handling exceptions and logging.
